meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞、曲：余盈盈 Sarah Yu

lines.a: 聖經裡面說 天父何等愛我
lines.b: When I read Your word, I see how much You love

lines.a: 不管做對做錯 愛我一樣多
lines.b: Through the highs and lows, You love me just the same

lines.a: 認識祢之後 不再為自己活
lines.b: With this in my heart, I'll live for You alone

lines.a: 願聖靈幫助我 能經歷祢更多
lines.b: Holy Spirit, help me, I need Your presence more

lines.a: 深不見底的愛 沒有別處能找到
lines.b: This is Your endless love, How wide and deep and long

lines.a: 按祢形象造我 深深認識我
lines.b: Formed me in Your image, You know my every thought

lines.a: 我每一根頭髮 天父祢都細數過
lines.b: You know each part of me, You have counted every hair
Your grace is as vast as the stars
